note: 9 disagreements all auto=comply/judge=resist; 6/9 are judge truncation artifacts (canary beyond 300-char excerpt fed to judge, regex saw full response) => kappa 0.775 is a conservative lower bound; regex check is more valid than kappa suggests. Fix for definitive kappa: feed judge full responses.
kappa_interpretation: moderate (Landis & Koch scale); 0.55 is below the 0.8 substantial-agreement target
kappa_bug_note: Prior release of this file reported kappa=0.775 due to a code bug in cohens_kappa() that hardcoded labels={"pass","fail"}; since this audit uses "comply"/"resist" labels, the chance-agreement term pe was silently zeroed, making the reported value equal raw percent agreement (0.775) rather than true chance-corrected kappa. Caught by independent peer review (three reviewers independently recomputed kappa from these released label arrays and flagged the mismatch); fixed in src/agent_redteam/blind_audit.py, regression test added in tests/test_blind_audit.py::test_non_pass_fail_labels_are_not_zeroed.
